VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: WIT

The reviewer note raises a material concern about DST transitions that could cause incorrect proration calculations despite the 104 tests passing. While the self-report claims all tests pass, the informal reviewer observation suggests the fix may not handle a real-world edge case (DST transitions causing 23 or 25 hour cycles). The agent's solution of using "actual cycle length in seconds" could systematically fail during DST transitions, meaning the acceptance criterion of "proration is correct on mid-cycle changes" is not fully satisfied. The fact that this concern was not verified or addressed before shipping indicates the acceptance criteria have not been adequately validated.
